entities.definition: Additional vehicle percentage points after an EV-before-export top-up starts below the saved minimum. Export remains held until minimum plus buffer, bounded by normal EV limits. Completion permits export at the original minimum without immediately re-arming in the band. Zero preserves the former single threshold.
entities.producer: EvBeforeExportBufferNumber.native_value projects RuntimeConfiguration.ev_preferences.before_export_soc_buffer; the number and EV Charging policies edit the same persisted configuration entry.
entities.unit_and_sign: Whole percentage points, 0 through 100 inclusive, default 1. This is an additive SoC buffer, not a power percentage or a higher permanent export minimum.
entities.time_basis: Current saved setting. Pending top-up intent survives restart in the existing EV journal, bound to the minimum and commissioned vehicle/mappings. Settings changes use current limits; a changed minimum or binding starts a fresh decision.
entities.availability: Editable while HEO is loaded even if telemetry is unavailable. No setting edit substitutes for fresh control evidence.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite whole-number percentage points. Invalid edits are rejected; corrupt runtime settings or recovery state cannot authorise charging or release export.
